sql.query: UPDATE tbl_workflow_stages target INNER JOIN tbl_workflows w ON w.id=target.workflowId AND w.tenantId=target.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages currentStage ON currentStage.id=w.currentStageId AND currentStage.tenantId=w.tenantId SET target.status='in_progress',target.startedDate=COALESCE(target.startedDate,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP),target.modifiedDate=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE w.id=:recordId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId AND w.currentStageId=:expectedStage AND currentStage.nextWorkflowStageId=target.id AND target.id=:targetStage AND currentStage.allowNextStageEarlyStart=1 AND target.status='not_started' AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM tbl_user_tenant_roles utr INNER JOIN tbl_role_permissions rp ON rp.roleId=utr.roleId INNER JOIN tbl_permissions p ON p.id=rp.permissionId AND p.isActive=1 WHERE utr.userId=:userId AND utr.tenantId=:tenantId2 AND utr.isActive=1 AND p.permissionCode='workflows.edit')

options.message: The next phase could not be started. Refresh the event and check that early start is enabled.

sql.query: INSERT INTO tbl_activity_log (tenantId,userId,workflowId,entityType,entityId,actionType,summary,afterJson,createdDate) SELECT :tenantId,:userId,w.id,'workflow',w.id,'workflow.stage.early_started',CONCAT(:actor,' started ',target.stageName,' early while ',currentStage.stageName,' remained current'),JSON_OBJECT('currentStageId',currentStage.id,'startedStageId',target.id,'parallel',TRUE),CURRENT_TIMESTAMP FROM tbl_workflows w INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages currentStage ON currentStage.id=w.currentStageId AND currentStage.tenantId=w.tenantId INNER JOIN tbl_workflow_stages target ON target.id=:targetStage AND target.workflowId=w.id AND target.tenantId=w.tenantId WHERE w.id=:recordId AND w.tenantId=:tenantId2

data.message: The next phase has started. The current phase remains open.
